claim: In a damped oscillator with a three-well potential the basin boundary is fractal: its uncertainty exponent is bounded away from the smooth value of 1 and away from the structureless shuffled floor of ~0, and the two-well boundary is not fractal. Holds across damping.
name: fractal_basin
reason: all three conditions met at >= 4/5 seeds in every swept gamma
refute_if: alpha_triple >= 0.90, OR (alpha_double - alpha_triple) < 0.10, OR (alpha_triple - alpha_null) < 0.20 - any one of these at >=3 of 5 seeds in any swept gamma

claim: A snap-through event acts as an analogue-to-digital converter: mutual information between the load at which the snap occurred and the post-snap ringdown frequency exceeds a permutation null by a margin not attributable to estimator bias, across damping.
name: snap_information
reason: gamma=0.02: excess MI < 0.2 bits at 5/5 seeds; gamma=0.05: excess MI < 0.2 bits at 5/5 seeds; gamma=0.1: excess MI < 0.2 bits at 5/5 seeds
refute_if: MI(load; ringdown) - MI_null < 0.20 bits at >=3 of 5 seeds in any swept gamma

claim: Differential probe-recovery time (bistable arm / rigid arm) tested at one pre-committed compression checkpoint detects an approaching snap-through with at least 15% lead on the load range, at >=80% detection and <=10% false positive on a rigid creep-only null, robust to timing noise up to 10%.
name: ep2_prereg
reason: pre-committed checkpoint: detection >= 0.8 and null false positive <= 0.1 at >= 4/5 seeds in every swept timing noise
refute_if: detection_rate_checkpoint < 0.80 OR null_false_positive_checkpoint > 0.10 - either at >=3 of 5 seeds in any swept timing_noise

claim: Along the gradient-ascent weight-perturbation ray, effective curvature kappa_eff = |v'Hv|/v'v peaks before held-out accuracy collapses, robustly across the choice of accuracy-drop threshold, and with a larger lead than a random ray gives.
name: kappa_eff
reason: threshold=0.02: K1/K2 fired at 5/5 seeds; threshold=0.02: gradient ray's lead no better than a random ray's at 3/5 seeds; threshold=0.05: K1/K2 fired at 5/5 seeds; threshold=0.05: gradient ray's lead no better than a random ray's at 4/5 seeds; threshold=0.1: K1/K2 fired at 5/5 seeds; threshold=0.1: gradient ray's lead no better than a random ray's at 4/5 seeds
refute_if: K1 or K2 fires on the gradient ray, OR lead_gradient - lead_random <= 0 - either at >=3 of 5 seeds in any swept accuracy_drop_threshold

claim: In an octahedron with one bistable strut, probe-recovery time diverges before the snap with at least 15% of the compression range of warning, and a matched monostable arm does not produce the same divergence - so the signal is the fold, not the loading.
name: shape_csd
reason: probe=0.08: monostable arm rises as early as the bistable one at 4/5 seeds
refute_if: lead_frac < 0.15 OR null_lead_frac >= lead_frac - either at >=3 of 5 seeds in any swept probe_magnitude

claim: The uncertainty exponent measured for the triple-well basin boundary is converged in grid resolution and integration time: doubling either changes alpha by less than 0.05, at every damping swept.
name: basin_convergence
reason: gamma=0.1: |alpha(2N) - alpha(N)| >= 0.05 at 5/5 seeds; gamma=0.25: |alpha(2N) - alpha(N)| >= 0.05 at 5/5 seeds; gamma=0.5: |alpha(2N) - alpha(N)| >= 0.05 at 5/5 seeds
refute_if: |alpha(2N) - alpha(N)| >= 0.05 OR |alpha(2T) - alpha(T)| >= 0.05 - either at >=3 of 5 seeds in any swept gamma

claim: Effective curvature kappa_eff along the gradient-ascent ray RISES to at least 2x its baseline before held-out accuracy drops 5 points, across network widths, and by the time equal damage is done the gradient ray's curvature has risen further than a random ray's.
name: kappa_eff_g1
reason: width=16: the 2.0x rise does not precede the 5% drop at 5/5 seeds; width=32: the 2.0x rise does not precede the 5% drop at 4/5 seeds; width=64: the 2.0x rise does not precede the 5% drop at 5/5 seeds; width=64: at matched damage the gradient ray's curvature has risen no further than a random ray's at 5/5 seeds
refute_if: alpha_rise >= alpha_drop (the 2x rise does not precede the 5-point accuracy drop), OR kappa_ratio_at_drop_gradient <= kappa_ratio_at_drop_random - either at >=3 of 5 seeds in any swept hidden_width

claim: With a monostable control arm matched to the bistable arm in BOTH geometry (same rest length 1.8) and stiffness, probe-recovery time on the bistable arm still diverges before the snap with at least 15% of the compression range of warning, and the control does not.
name: shape_csd_g1
reason: recovery-time ratio crosses 1.5x with >= 15% lead, beating the monostable null, at >= 4/5 seeds at every probe magnitude
refute_if: lead_frac < 0.15 OR null_lead_frac >= lead_frac - either at >=3 of 5 seeds in any swept probe_magnitude
